result.instructions: Tools for Clearooms, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which meeting rooms are free tomorrow afternoon at 14:00 to 15:00?"; "Show me who has a desk booked on the third floor next Monday."; "List my desk bookings for this week and cancel the one on Friday.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Clearooms data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run clearooms_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run clearooms_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run clearooms_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. clearooms_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: clearooms_get_current_user
tools.title: Get current user
tools.description: Get the Clearooms user that owns this API token: name, email, role and office. No scope needed. Clearooms API: GET /users/me.

tools.name: clearooms_list_offices
tools.title: List offices
tools.description: List the offices this token may access, ordered by display order. Use the office ids with the desk and room tools. Scope: read. Clearooms API: GET /offices.

tools.name: clearooms_list_rooms
tools.title: List meeting rooms
tools.description: List meeting rooms in the organisation. Give date and office_id to include each room's availability for that day. Scope: read. Clearooms API: GET /rooms.

date.description: Return availability on this day. Requires office_id.

office_id.description: Only return rooms in this office. Required with date.

search.description: Search rooms by name. Ignored when date is given.

tools.name: clearooms_get_room
tools.title: Get a meeting room
tools.description: Get one meeting room by id: name, capacity, office and settings. Scope: read. Clearooms API: GET /rooms/{roomId}.

tools.name: clearooms_check_room_availability
tools.title: Check room availability
tools.description: Check whether a meeting room can be booked at the given times on each date in a range, applying the room's rules. Extra rooms must all be free. Scope: meetings.manage. Clearooms API: GET /rooms/availability.

start_time.description: Meeting start time in the office's timezone, H:mm.

end_time.description: Meeting end time in the office's timezone, H:mm.

additional_rooms.description: Other room ids the meeting also occupies.

selected_dates.description: Dates already selected; passed to the availability rules.

tools.name: clearooms_list_meetings
tools.title: List meetings
tools.description: List meetings on one date or across a date range. Dates are whole days in UTC, or in the office's timezone when office_id is given. Not paginated. Scope: meetings.read. Clearooms API: GET /meetings.

date.description: Meetings on this day. Use this or start_date.

start_date.description: First day of a range. Use with end_date.

end_date.description: Last day of a range. Use with start_date.

office_id.description: Only meetings in this office. Dates are read in its timezone.

tools.name: clearooms_list_bookings
tools.title: List desk bookings
tools.description: List desk and parking bookings in the organisation for one day, a date range, or every booking active on a day. Bookings in disabled offices are left out unless the token is an admin's. Clearooms API: GET /bookings.

date.description: The day, or the start of a range when end_date is given. Required unless active_at_date is given.

active_at_date.description: Every booking that overlaps this day. Takes priority over date.

team_id.description: Only bookings for members of this team.

tools.name: clearooms_get_booking
tools.title: Get a booking
tools.description: Get one desk or parking booking by id, with its times, desk, user and status. Clearooms API: GET /bookings/{bookingId}.

tools.name: clearooms_list_my_bookings
tools.title: List my bookings
tools.description: List the bookings of the user who owns this token. Give date, or a from and to date-time range. Set unconfirmed to list only unconfirmed bookings. Scope: bookings.view. Clearooms API: GET /users/me/bookings.

tools.name: clearooms_list_desks
tools.title: List desks
tools.description: List desks and parking spaces in the organisation. Give office_id and date to get each desk's availability that day (this turns off search and sorting). Scope: bookings.view. Clearooms API: GET /desks.

office_id.description: Only desks in this office. Required with date.

date.description: Return availability on this day. Requires office_id.

search.description: Filter by desk, office, user or team name. Ignored with date.

sort_direction.description: The sort direction, for example asc or desc.

tools.name: clearooms_check_desk_availability
tools.title: Check desk availability
tools.description: Check whether a desk can be booked on each date from `from` to `to`, using the office's working hours unless start_time and end_time are given. Scope: bookings.view. Clearooms API: GET /desks/availability.

start_time.description: Start time on each date, HH:mm. Defaults to the start of working hours.

end_time.description: End time on each date, HH:mm. Defaults to the end of working hours.

selected_dates.description: Dates already chosen for this booking.

user_id.description: The user to check for. Defaults to the token's user.

guest.description: Whether the booking is for a guest.

tools.name: clearooms_get_bookings_report
tools.title: Get a bookings report
tools.description: Get every booking that starts or ends between two dates, for reporting. Both dates may be the same day. Not paginated. Scope: reports.view. Clearooms API: GET /reports/bookings/{from}/{to}.

tools.name: clearooms_create_desk_booking
tools.title: Book a desk
tools.description: Book a desk for the token's user, or for another user with user_id. Give date and end_date for consecutive days, or dates for specific slots. Clearooms only books dates that pass the availability checks; it returns HTTP 422 when none do. Scope: bookings.create.own (or bookings.create.others). Clearooms API: POST /bookings.

date.description: Start of the booking, date-time. Required unless dates is given.

end_date.description: End of the booking, date-time. Required unless all_day is true or dates is given.

dates.description: Specific slots, each on a different day. Used instead of date and end_date.

user_id.description: The user the booking is for. Defaults to the token's user.

tools.name: clearooms_cancel_booking
tools.title: Cancel a booking
tools.description: Cancel a desk or parking booking by id, along with any bookings linked to it. Some offices require a cancellation_reason id. Scope: bookings.create.own (own bookings) or bookings.delete.others. Clearooms API: DELETE /bookings/{bookingId}.

cancellation_reason.description: An active cancellation reason id for this kind of desk, or other.

cancellation_note.description: A note, up to 500 characters. Required with some reasons.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Clearooms
prompts.description: What you can do with Clearooms here, with example requests to try.
